title: Concept: TLS verification disabled in the Yarn configuration
description: .yarnrc declares a `.yarnrc` `enableStrictSsl` switch set to false, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a `.yarnrc` `enableStrictSsl` switch set to false.
